name: Ride to Ironforge
summary: You carry Brock Stoneseeker's list from Thelsamar to Golnir Bouldertoe at Ironforge's Great Forge. The names belong to Brock's top mining students.

sections.title: Taking to the Skies
sections.body: Young mountaineers and travelers often make their first gryphon flight between Thelsamar and Ironforge. Gryphon Master Thorgrum Borrelson handles the trip, carrying travelers over Dun Morogh's snowy ridges and into the mountain fortress.

sections.title: Honors of the Deep Mountain Guild
sections.body: Brock Stoneseeker sends word from Thelsamar about his most promising mining pupils. At the Great Forge, Golnir Bouldertoe inscribes their names on ceremonial honorary picks, recognizing their hard work in Loch Modan's quarries and mines.

faq.q: Where does this flight start and end?
faq.answer: The flight begins with Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar, Loch Modan, and ends at the flight roost by the Great Forge in Ironforge.
Brock Stoneseeker's list names his finest mining students in Thelsamar so the guild in Ironforge can recognize their diligence.
Golnir Bouldertoe represents the Deep Mountain Mining Guild at Ironforge's Great Forge. He receives rosters from local trainers and chisels the students' names into honorary picks.

faq.q: What happens after you deliver the list?
faq.answer: After Golnir receives the roster, he sends you to Gryth Thurden, Ironforge's master gryphon handler, to learn about the kingdom's aerial routes.

faq.q: Why use a gryphon instead of walking?
faq.answer: The mountain road and tunnels reach Ironforge's Gates, but the gryphon flight teaches you how quickly Alliance travelers can move between settlements.
An honorary pick is a ceremonial tool the Deep Mountain Mining Guild gives to outstanding mining students who have learned basic excavation and geology from regional instructors.

angles.text: As a miner, you see how the Deep Mountain Mining Guild recognizes promising miners from Loch Modan's pits by engraving their names.
As a young Bronzebeard dwarf, your gryphon flight into the Great Forge marks a proud passage from rural outposts to the heart of the kingdom.
As an Alliance traveler, you can rely on gryphon routes to connect Khaz Modan's frontline garrisons with its capital.
